source.title: p-quotients of the G. Higman group
source.author: Lev Glebsky
checked_claims: Introduction: p divides k-1 gives unbounded p-quotients and kernel intersection trivial on adjacent Baumslag–Solitar subgroups.
Corollary 1: quotients onto Zappa–Szep products of free p-class quotients, retaining unbounded orders of generators.
The cyclic order-four generator permutation is evident from presentation and induces continuous automorphisms of pro-p completion.
source.verification_limit: Prior theorem used as a structural control; entire ring-theoretic proof not independently reproduced or formally verified. It does not exhibit relative isolation or a uniform family of small conjugators.
